metadata.question: Did the aerosol optical depth over the Sichuan Basin in southwestern China decrease between 2006 and 2020?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS MAIAC AOD (MODIS/061/MCD19A2) band Optical_Depth_055 over a polygon approximating the Sichuan Basin (102–108.5E, 28–32.8N). Compare annual composites for 2006 and 2020. If empty, fall back to MODIS/061/MOD04_3K, then MODIS/061/MYD04_3K.
2. Masking strategy: For AOD, mask invalid values outside [0, 5]. No cloud masking; MAIAC/DT-DB retrievals exclude clouds by design. Use median of daily images per year to reduce outliers.
3. Valid Zero vs. Null/Error: AOD in [0, 5] is valid. If mean is null/NaN or outside this range, return C3. If collections exist but valid pixel count is 0 after masking, return C2. If no images found for either year after fallbacks, return C1. Any runtime/dataset/band errors return D.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  function getInfoAsync(eeObj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.getInfo(resolve, reject));
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[102.0, 28.0], [108.5, 28.0], [108.5, 32.8], [102.0, 32.8], [102.0, 28.0]]
  ]);
  const yearA = 2006;
  const yearB = 2020;
  const scale = 3000; // km-scale to keep computations robust

  // 2. Dataset selection with fallbacks
  const candidates = [
    { id: 'MODIS/061/MCD19A2', band: 'Optical_Depth_055', desc: 'MCD19A2 MAIAC 1km' },
    { id: 'MODIS/061/MOD04_3K', band: 'Optical_Depth_055', desc: 'MOD04_3K Terra 3km' },
    { id: 'MODIS/061/MYD04_3K', band: 'Optical_Depth_055', desc: 'MYD04_3K Aqua 3km' }
  ];

  async function tryCandidate(c) {
    try {
      const base = ee.ImageCollection(c.id).select(c.band).filterBounds(roi);
      const sA = await getInfoAsync(base.filterDate(`${yearA}-01-01`, `${yearA + 1}-01-01`).size());
      const sB = await getInfoAsync(base.filterDate(`${yearB}-01-01`, `${yearB + 1}-01-01`).size());
      return { ok: true, base, sA, sB, c };
    } catch (e) {
      return { ok: false, error: e };
    }
  }

  let chosen = null;
  for (const c of candidates) {
    const res = await tryCandidate(c);
    if (res.ok && res.sA > 0 && res.sB > 0) {
      chosen = res;
      break;
    }
  }

  if (!chosen) {
    // If none had both years, report if any had one year; else C1
    console.log('No dataset with images for both years after fallbacks.');
    console.log('C1');
    return;
  }

  const baseCol = chosen.base;
  const band = chosen.c.band;
  console.log(`Dataset: ${chosen.c.id} (${chosen.c.desc}), Band: ${band}`);
  console.log(`${yearA} Images: ${chosen.sA}`);
  console.log(`${yearB} Images: ${chosen.sB}`);

  // 3. Processing helpers
  const validMask = function (img) {
    const a = img.select(band);
    const m = a.gte(0).and(a.lte(5));
    return a.updateMask(m);
  };

  async function yearStats(y) {
    const col = baseCol.filterDate(`${y}-01-01`, `${y + 1}-01-01`).map(validMask);
    const med = col.median(); // robust annual composite
    // Count valid and total pixels
    const stats = med.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const tot = ee.Image(1).rename('c').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    });
    const dict = await getInfoAsync(stats);
    const totDict = await getInfoAsync(tot);
    const mean = dict ? dict[`${band}_mean`] : null;
    const validCount = dict ? dict[`${band}_count`] : 0;
    const totalCount = totDict ? totDict['c'] : 0;
    return { mean, validCount, totalCount };
  }

  try {
    const a = await yearStats(yearA);
    const b = await yearStats(yearB);

    if (a.totalCount === 0 || b.totalCount === 0) {
      console.log('Region had 0 total pixels at chosen scale.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if ((a.validCount || 0) === 0 || (b.validCount || 0) === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking in at least one year.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    const isInvalid = (v) => v === null || v === undefined || Number.isNaN(v) || v < 0 || v > 5;
    if (isInvalid(a.mean) || isInvalid(b.mean)) {
      console.log('Computed mean AOD invalid (null/NaN/out of range).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const pctA = (a.validCount / a.totalCount) * 100;
    const pctB = (b.validCount / b.totalCount) * 100;
    const change = b.mean - a.mean;

    console.log(`${yearA} Valid px: ${a.validCount} of ${a.totalCount} (${pctA.toFixed(1)}%), Mean AOD: ${a.mean.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(`${yearB} Valid px: ${b.validCount} of ${b.totalCount} (${pctB.toFixed(1)}%), Mean AOD: ${b.mean.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(`Change ${yearB}-${yearA}: ${change.toFixed(3)}`);

    if (change < 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err.message || err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
